sentences.english: The soldier rode up to Drake.
sentences.korean: 士兵骑马来到了德雷克身边。

sentences.english: He reached down and pulled him up onto his horse.
sentences.korean: 他伸下手去，把他拉上了自己的马。
sentences.details:
[[reach]]
reach / riːtʃ / 리치 / ~에 닿다, 도달하다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 到达, 伸手去拿, 范围
reach / reached / reached / reaching

Can you reach the top shelf?
We will reach the city soon.
He reached for the red ball.

你能碰到顶层的架子吗？
我们很快就会到达城市。
他伸手去拿那个红球。

[[reach down]]
reach down / riːtʃ daʊn / 리치 다운 / 손을 아래로 뻗다
[V / 动词] 伸手向下
reach down / reached down / reached down / reaching down

Please reach down and pick it up.
I reach down to tie my shoes.
She reached down into the deep bag.

请弯腰把它捡起来。
我弯下腰系鞋带。
她把手伸进深袋子里。

[[pull up]]
pull up / pʊl ʌp / 풀 업 / 끌어올리다, 멈추다
[V / 动词] 拉上来, 停住
pull up / pulled up / pulled up / pulling up

Pull up your socks, please.
The car pulled up at the gate.
Help me pull up these weeds.

请拉好你的袜子。
汽车在门口停了下来。
帮我把这些杂草拔出来。

[[onto]]
onto / ˈɒntu / 온투 / ~ 위로
[Prep / 介词] 到...之上

The cat jumped onto the table.
Step onto the bus carefully.
He put the book onto the desk.

猫跳到了桌子上。
小心地走上公交车。
他把书放在书桌上。

sentences.english: "Hey, what are you doing?" Drake yelled.
sentences.korean: “嘿，你在做什么？” 德雷克大喊道。
sentences.details:
[[yell]]
yell / jel / 옐 / 소리치다, 고함지르다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 叫喊, 大喊
yell / yelled / yelled / yelling

Do not yell in the library.
I had to yell for help.
They yell when they are happy.

不要在图书馆里大喊大叫。
我不得不大声呼救。
他们开心时会大喊。

sentences.english: Drake's mother ran out of their hut.
sentences.korean: 德雷克的母亲从他们的简陋小屋里跑了出来。
sentences.details:
[[run]]
run / rʌn / 런 / 달리다, 운영하다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 跑, 经营
run / ran / run / running

I run in the park every morning.
Can you run as fast as a dog?
The water is still running.

我每天早晨在公园跑步 tube。
你能跑得像狗一样快吗？
水还在流。

[[run out]]
run out / rʌn aʊt / 런 아웃 / 다 떨어지다, 밖으로 뛰어나가다
[V / 动词] 用完, 跑出去
run out / ran out / run out / running out

We will run out of milk soon.
The children run out to play.
Time is starting to run out.

我们的牛奶很快就要喝光了。
孩子们跑出去玩了。
时间快要用完了。

[[hut]]
hut / hʌt / 헛 / 오두막, 막사
[N / 名词] 小屋, 茅屋

The old man lives in a hut.
We built a small hut with wood.
It is cold inside the hut.

那位老人住在一间小屋里。
我们用木头盖了一个小棚子。
小屋里很冷。

sentences.english: Where are you taking my boy?" she yelled.
sentences.korean: 你要把我的孩子带到哪里去？” 她大喊道。

sentences.details:
[[heart]]
heart / hɑːrt / 하트 / 마음, 심장
[N / 名词] 心, 心脏

My heart beats very fast.
She has a very kind heart.
Draw a red heart on the paper.

我的心跳得很快。
她有一颗善良的心。
在纸上画一颗红心。

[[jump]]
jump / dʒʌmp / 점프 / 뛰다, 점프하다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 跳跃
jump / jumped / jumped / jumping

The frog can jump very high.
I jump over the small puddle.
Don't jump on the bed.

青蛙可以跳得很高。
我跳过了小水坑。
不要在床上跳。

sentences.english: He had always wanted to meet the king.
sentences.details:
[[want]]
want / wɒnt / 원트 / 원하다, 바라다
[V / 动词] 想要
want / wanted / wanted / wanting

I want a big ice cream.
Do you want to play soccer?
She wants a new bike for Christmas.

我想要一个大冰淇淋。
你想踢足球吗？
她想要一辆新自行车作为圣诞礼物。

sentences.english: "But he's only eight!" his mother yelled.
sentences.korean: “但他只有八岁！” 他的母亲大喊道。

sentences.english: She marched up to the horse.
sentences.details:
[[march]]
march / mɑːrtʃ / 마취 / 행진하다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 前进, 行军, 三月
march / marched / marched / marching

The soldiers march in a line.
We march to the music.
The band will march in the parade.

士兵们排队行进。
我们随着音乐齐步走。
乐队将在游行中行进。

[[march up]]
march up / mɑːrtʃ ʌp / 마취 업 / ~로 당당하게 걸어가다
[V / 动词] 向上行进, 走到...面前
march up / marched up / marched up / marching up

The king marched up the hill.
She marched up to the teacher.
The students march up the stairs.

国王走上了山丘。
她大步走向老师。
学生们走上楼梯。
